title: PleaseRestart
description: A simple and lightweight server restart tool for Paper
body:
# PleaseRestart 🙏
A simple tool to restart your server when a certain amount of players (or none) are logged in.

# Setup 🛠️
Depending on your server host, restarts may be completely set up by default! In the case your server is self hosted visit [this guide](https://gist.github.com/Prof-Bloodstone/6367eb4016eaf9d1646a88772cdbbac5) for setting up a restart script.

# Commands
`/pleaserestart` (`/plsrestart`): Run this command to queue or unqueue a restart.
### Permissions:
- pleaserestart.command.pleaserestart: Grants all the permissions below
- pleaserestart.command.pleaserestart.start: Allows queueing a restart
- pleaserestart.command.pleaserestart.stop: Allow unqueuing a restart
